text.tspan: UNESCO Rhine Gorge region making medium-bodied Riesling that blends Rheingau, Nahe and Mosel
Most wine is consumed locally via Rhine tourism; little is exported despite rising quality
A shrinking region saved by 1960s restructuring that consolidated its best sites
Two Bereiche only: Loreley and tiny volcanic Siebengebirge
Mittelrhein vs Mosel: both steep slate Riesling, but Rhine vs Mosel river
Loreley is both a landmark AND the main Bereich name
Bacharach Feuerwein was heated must, not a grape or vineyard
UNESCO Rhine Gorge; 120 km, Bonn to Bingen
Small and shrinking: 460 ha, over 50% steep terraces
